'''Stout''' was the name of [[Galadedrid Damodred]]'s warhorse.

==Appearance==
Stout was a bay-colored gelding.{{ref/book|11|p}}

==Activities==
Stout carried Galad when the [[Lord Captain]] confronted [[Eamon Valda]].{{ref/book|11|p}} Stout was later led through a swamp and then ridden by Galad, who was [[Lord Captain Commander]] by that time, through a camp of the [[Children of the Light]].{{ref/book|13|p}}{{ref/book|13|4}} During a [[Trolloc]] attack on the camp, Stout was killed.{{ref/book|13|41}}
